name: Toll-Bell Wraith
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Bell-Slumber
Traits.text: If the toll-bell wraith's grave-bell is not intact, the toll-bell wraith can doff its slumber: while its grave-bell lies silent, the toll-bell wraith is not subject to the sleep condition and cannot be put to sleep by magic or by the bell.

Traits.name: Grave-Bell Toll
Traits.text: The toll-bell wraith keeps its grave-bell within 30 feet of itself. That object has AC 17, HP 25, and Resistance to all damage. While it is intact, the toll-bell wraith regains 20 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns.
Traits.gmQuote: tolls once for fear twice for sleep and three times for the grave
Traits.expresses: tolling the bell one, two, three times

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The toll-bell wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.text: While in sunlight, the toll-bell wraith has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The toll-bell wraith makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Grave Toll.

Actions.name: Cold-Handed Strike
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 5 ft. 51 (10d8 + 6) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Grave Toll
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

lore: A bell-wraith is what remains of a sacristan or watchman who died tolling an alarm no one answered, and it now tolls its own dead count over any breathing thing it finds in the dark.

generation.userConcept: a bell-wraith that tolls once for fear, twice for sleep, and three times for the grave
generation.cite: composition after Wraith (CR 5) — Life Drain under the sunlight bane

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
